description: Use this when the person wants to see what Andru reads about a company's website before they have an Andru account. Returns who the company sells to, the buyers who decide, and what the site says versus what those buyers need to hear. Send the website. No account needed. Takes about a minute: you get a preview_id; call again with it to collect the read. If the person signs up with signup_start and this preview_id, the read becomes their first ICP.

previewId.description: From an earlier call, to collect the read.

name: preview_company
title: Preview a company
